headline: Salvage Company Hoping to Sell Titanic Artifacts Challenges Court’s Role
context: A Virginia federal court has awarded the company the rights to collect, but not sell, items from the shipwreck. But the company says its earliest retrievals are governed by a French court.

sources.name: The New York Times
